svg.aria-label: Side-by-side weight grids for three layers. Left, a float convolutional network drawn as continuous dithered tone. Right, the delay-line network of the same shape drawn as crossbar pads: 85 of 128, 315 of 512 and 316 of 512 populated, each outlined pink for plus one or blue for minus one, empty pads dashed. Below, the eight layer-1 kernels of each network as small waveforms over eight taps.
svg.text: tap delay 0 to 6.74 µs, 962.5 ns per tap on the designed ladder

g.text: the conventional picture: every weight of a float network as a continuous tone, the way a trained filter bank is
usually shown. Coarse screen positive, fine screen negative.
the same grid for the delay-line net, as the tile would show it: a pink-outlined pad is a resistor to the + summer,
blue to the −, dashed is left empty. These are the populated resistors in the placement file, one for one.
a kernel read along its taps is a frozen waveform. The CNN’s is a curve; the delay-line net’s is a row of ±1 stems
